reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per day with orders
  SELECT order_date, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'NL-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_date
)
SELECT order_date, revenue_eur,
  SUM(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_revenue_eur
FROM daily
alternatives:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per day with orders
  SELECT order_date, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'NL-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_date
)
SELECT d.order_date, d.revenue_eur,
  (SELECT SUM(d2.revenue_eur) FROM daily d2 WHERE d2.order_date <= d.order_date) AS running_revenue_eur

WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per day with orders
  SELECT order_date, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'NL-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_date
)
SELECT d.order_date, d.revenue_eur, SUM(e.revenue_eur) AS running_revenue_eur
FROM daily d
JOIN daily e ON e.order_date <= d.order_date
GROUP BY d.order_date, d.revenue_eur
